description: Paid: US$0.02 per call in USDC over x402 (or 20 prepaid credits). Product search across big retailers and brand stores (deepest in Australia, also US), with the top results checked on the retailer page at the moment of the call: live price, stock and whether the link still works. Not charged if no page could be read. Without payment the result is an x402 payment request; attach the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"] and call again. For free results as last recorded, use search_products.
